test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Amongst six friends A, B, C, D, E an F, each has a different height. F is taller than only two other friends. A is shorter than only one friend. D is shorter than F but taller than C. E is shorter than B. Who is the third tallest among all the friends ?
solution:
Amongst six friends A, B, C, D, E an F, each has a different height. 

1. F is taller than only two other friends. 

__ > __ > __ > F > __ > __

2. A is shorter than only one friend. 

__ > A > __ > F > __ > __

3. D is shorter than F but taller than C. 

F > D > C

4. E is shorter than B. 

B > E

From 1, 2, 3 and 4, we get:

B > A > E > F > D > C

Clearly, E is the third tallest among all the friends.

Hence, ‘**E**’ is the correct answer.
